title: Malahide to Howth Coastal Walk Route

images.title: Mprasannak, CC BY-SA 4.0 <https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0>, via Wikimedia Commons
images.caption: Howth Harbour Lighthouse, Howth Harbour

description: This walk takes you from Malahide to the Howth Cliff Walk near Dublin. The route runs for just over 13km mostly following the coastal paths and then some minor roads into Howth. The walk starts in Malahide in Fingal and heads south to Portmarnock with some excellent views over the Broadmeadow River estuary. You continue past the Baldoyle Estuary Nature Reserve where you can look out for a large variety of wading birds. The route then continues east to finish at Howth next to the picturesque harbour.
